gloss: origin of a fire; source of a fire

definitions.gloss: origin of a fire; source of a fire
definitions.explanation: The point where a fire started, or the person or household responsible for causing a fire.

examples.japanese: {火元|ひもと}は{台所|だいどころ}だった。
examples.english: The fire originated in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: {消防士|しょうぼうし}が{火元|ひもと}を{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: Firefighters are investigating the source of the fire.

examples.japanese: {火元|ひもと}となった{住宅|じゅうたく}の{住人|じゅうにん}は、コンロの{火|ひ}を{消|け}し{忘|わす}れたと{証言|しょうげん}した。
examples.english: The resident of the house where the fire originated testified that they forgot to turn off the stove.

notes:
Composed of {火|ひ} (fire) + {元|もと} (origin, source). Used in fire investigation and news reports. Can refer to either the physical location where a fire started or the responsible party.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火元|ひもと}を{調|しら}べる: to investigate the source of a fire
- {火元|ひもと}を{特定|とくてい}する: to identify the origin of a fire
- {火元|ひもと}となる: to be the source of a fire
- {火元|ひもと}{不明|ふめい}: unknown origin of fire
- {火元|ひもと}の{不注意|ふちゅうい}: carelessness at the source of fire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出火|しゅっか}: outbreak of fire — the event of a fire starting
- {火災|かさい}: fire (disaster) — the fire itself as a disaster
- {火種|ひだね}: spark, source of trouble — can be literal or figurative
